title: Write tool: log a crash, gated as an action needing approval
goal: NERV can log a crash through FPVBuddy only after the owner approves it
acceptance: An MCP tool logs a crash through the F-010 core (drone, category, position, damage, optional new or used spare); it is annotated as a write (not read-only, not idempotent) so NERV gates it as an action needing approval; invalid input is refused with the core's errors
Specs cover the annotation, a logged crash, a spent spare and a refused input; the tool table marks it as a write
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A surface type or page bricks lacks goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local copy in NERV

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one write tool on the core's recordCrash; the approval annotation NERV reads carries the uncertainty. Not a measurement.
